title: Waystone Contraption Compat
description: Put Waystones on Contraptions. And let them move along your contraption
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cad920da5b9c0771a57a58e83f970e83b1307d99.png)

# Move Waystones on Contraptions with this Compat Mod!

You no longer need to manually put the Waystone down everytime you stop the Contraption. Very useful for Drills but it will work on any glued contraption

_Be aware that you need to deactive the contraption to use the waystone itself. We tried to fix it but its currently not possible to use it when it's activated or even moving_


**You can use it freely in your Modpack, Do not redistribute!**
